$comment: The embedded Bun, pinned. Bun is COMMITTED rather than downloaded on demand (see
scripts/slang-toolchain.sh for why: every app build needs it, so it ships inside the platform
runtime packages a consumer restores). What it lacked was a pin and a checksum — the version
could only be learned by unzipping a binary and running it, and nothing proved the bytes were
BunToolchainTests verifies both: the digests, on every platform, on every run; and the version,
by extracting and executing the binary for the host platform.
To update: replace the .zip files, run the tests once with EQ_UPDATE_BUN_MANIFEST=1, and read
the diff — a version that moved and a digest that did not is a mistake, and so is the reverse.
